parallels.note: This is the first and great commandment.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

translations.web: The second is like this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

translations.kjv: And the second is like, namely this, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. There is none other commandment greater than these.
